gameDescriptionHtml:
A recon mission goes bad, and you are the only one who survive an enemy attack, you are left alone to survive in a dangerous area where the enemy has bases located. Your mission is to communicate with the base and ask for a rescue, to accomplish this, you will need to survive for a period in a harsh ambient.

Game Features

  • Vitals!: Managing your health, hunger and thirst will be a constant.
  • Fighting!: You will have to fight enemy soldiers
  • Hunting!: You will need to hunt animals
  • Explore!: You will explore an harsh ambient
  • Loot!: Search and loot enemy bases
  • Craft!: Crafting items and structures for your survival
  • Build!: You will need to build a base for your protection
  • Defend!: You will need to defend your position from enemies
